# Milens — Code Intelligence Engine

> Lightweight code intelligence platform — parses codebases into knowledge graphs, serves via MCP.

## What is milens?

milens indexes source code into a SQLite knowledge graph containing symbols (functions, classes, methods, interfaces, etc.) and their relationships (calls, imports, extends, implements, contains). It exposes this graph through 40+ MCP tools for AI agent consumption.

## MCP Tools

### Search & Navigation
- `query({query, limit?})` — BM25 full-text search across symbol names and file paths
- `grep({pattern, scope?, includePattern?})` — Text search ALL files — code, templates, configs, docs
- `context({name})` — 360° view: incoming refs + outgoing deps + exported status
- `get_file_symbols({file})` — All symbols in a specific file with relationship counts
- `get_type_hierarchy({name})` — Inheritance/implementation tree for a class, interface, or trait

### Impact & Safety
- `impact({target, direction?, depth?})` — Recursive graph traversal showing blast radius
- `edit_check({name})` — Pre-edit safety: callers + exports + re-export chains + test coverage + warnings
- `guard_edit_check({name, session_id})` — HARD pre-edit gate: blocks if dependents > 5, tracks checks for session audit
- `detect_changes({ref?})` — Git diff → affected symbols and their direct dependents
- `compare_impact({name, action})` — Before/after impact graph diff — snapshot then compare
- `find_dead_code({kind?, limit?})` — Exported symbols with zero incoming references

### Understanding
- `smart_context({name, intent})` — Intent-aware context: understand/edit/debug/test
- `trace({to?, from?})` — Execution flow: call chains to/from entrypoints
- `routes({framework?})` — Detect framework routes/endpoints (Express, FastAPI, NestJS, Flask, Go, PHP, Rails)
- `explain_relationship({from, to})` — Shortest path between two symbols
- `overview({name})` — Combined context + impact + grep in one call

### Codebase Overview
- `domains({})` — Domain clusters: groups of files forming logical modules
- `repos({})` — List all indexed repositories
- `status({})` — Index stats, domains, test coverage, accuracy report
- `codebase_summary({})` — High-level bootstrapping context for agents

### Review & Risk Assessment
- `review_pr({})` — PR risk assessment: scores changed symbols by blast radius + test coverage
- `review_symbol({name})` — Single symbol risk: role, heat, dependents, test status
- `pre_commit_check({})` — Pre-commit risk analysis: detect_changes + review_pr + dead code + coverage gaps
- `orchestrate({})` — Full orchestration cycle: detect_changes → review_pr → impact → coverage gaps → dead code

### Security
- `security_scan({scope?, severity?})` — Scan codebase for vulnerabilities using 190+ built-in rules
- `fix_apply({ruleId, file, line})` — Apply a security fix suggestion to a file with backup

### Testing
- `test_plan({name})` — Dependency-aware test plan: mocks, strategies, suggested tests
- `test_generate({symbol})` — Generate a test file using its test plan, following project conventions
- `test_coverage_gaps({})` — Untested exported symbols sorted by risk
- `test_impact({})` — Maps git changes → test files to run

### Developer Tools
- `ast_explore({code, language})` — Parse code snippet → S-expression AST tree
- `test_query({query, code, language})` — Test tree-sitter query against code snippet

### Annotations & Sessions
- `annotate({symbol, key, value})` — Store observation/note about a symbol (persists across sessions)
- `recall({symbol?, key?, agent?})` — Retrieve annotations
- `session_start({agent})` — Register agent session for multi-agent coordination
- `session_context({session_id})` — Get session metadata + annotations
- `session_end({session_id, status?})` — End a session, record stats and audit trail
- `handoff({from_session, to_agent, context})` — Transfer context between agent sessions
- `generate_findings_report({repo, title, findings})` — Render investigated findings into a Markdown+XML report

### Hooks
- `hook_onFileChange({files})` — Trigger onFileChange hook for impact summary after file modifications
- `hook_preCompact({})` — Save metrics snapshot before context window compaction
- `hook_postCompact({})` — Recall annotations to restore context after compaction

### Search & Similarity
- `semantic_search({query})` — Hybrid FTS5 + vector cosine similarity search (requires --embeddings)
- `find_similar({name})` — Find symbols with structurally similar dependency graphs (Jaccard similarity over shared callers/callees)

## Architecture

- **Parser**: Declarative `LangSpec` configs with tree-sitter query strings. One universal `extractFromTree()` function handles all 12 languages.
- **Analyzer**: Pipeline — scan files → group by language → parse/extract → resolve cross-file links → enrich (roles, heat, domains) → persist to SQLite.
- **Storage**: SQLite with FTS5 search, recursive CTEs for transitive dependency traversal, WAL mode.
- **Server**: MCP server with stdio and StreamableHTTP transports. 4 Resources + 13 guided workflow prompts.

## Supported Languages

TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Vue, HTML, CSS, Markdown

## CLI Commands

```
milens analyze -p <path>           # Index a repo
milens analyze -p . --force        # Force full re-index
milens analyze -p . --skills       # Index + generate skill files
milens init -p <path>              # One-command bootstrap: index + AGENTS.md + skills + hooks
milens init -p <path> --profile full  # Full profile with all tools enabled
milens uninstall -p <path>         # Safe removal: dry-run first, confirm before deleting
milens uninstall -p <path> --dry-run  # Preview what would be removed
milens search <query>              # Search symbols
milens inspect <symbol>            # 360° symbol view
milens impact <symbol>             # Blast radius
milens serve                       # Start MCP server (stdio)
milens serve --http                # Start MCP server (HTTP on port 3100)
milens status                      # Index stats
milens list                        # List all indexed repos
milens clean -p <path>             # Remove index
milens dashboard                   # Usage analytics dashboard
milens upgrade                     # Upgrade milens to latest version
milens hooks <action>              # Manage hooks (install, list, status, guard-set-mode)
milens workflow <action>           # Run workflows (review, plan, tdd, refactor, security, debug)
milens security scan -p <path>     # Run security scan
milens orchestrate                 # Full orchestration cycle
milens metrics                     # Code quality metrics (CQI, DCER, coverage)
```

## Setup

```bash
# Quick start (recommended): one-command bootstrap
npx milens init -p <path>

# Or manual steps:
npm install
npm run build
npx milens analyze -p <path>
```
